fixes.explanation: Nope, friend, Moses doesn't keep a single acre. Joshua 12:6 says the land was given "…as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh." The text calls him "…the servant of the LORD…" and that's the word it uses for him. He and the Israelites struck the kings down, and then the land went to those three groups. Nobody's holding the whole batch for himself here.

Careful, friend, this one's sneaky. Joshua and the Israelites did conquer those kings, that part is true. But the text says Joshua gave the land as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, "according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel…" (Joshua 12:7). So he won it and handed it out. He didn't keep it under his own rule.
